risk_note: RV2 (platform/media, platform/config). Media store port for the platform-icons backend (BR-TEXT-24 storage): MEDIA_STORE (Symbol) provided globally on every entry; put(sha256, bytes, contentType) validates a lowercase 64-hex digest equal to the SHA-256 of the bytes and is idempotent per digest; mediaUrlOf(base, sha256, format) builds <base>/<sha256>.<ext>; MEDIA_PUBLIC_BASE_URL read through platform/config (https only, no query, fragment, userinfo or whitespace; local / test default https://media.local.invalid; staging / prod may leave it unset without refusing to start). local / test use an in-memory stand-in; staging / prod (no OSS adapter yet, B1-30) fail each put and URL request with MediaStoreUnavailableError, mapped to HTTP 500 / 50001 by the global filter; logs carry the digest only. No real storage call, no secret. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
